title: Quotient of a Noetherian ring of dimension at most one by a nonzerodivisor has finite length
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (commutative) of Krull dimension $\dim R\le1$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $x\in R$ be a nonzerodivisor ($xa=0$ implies $a=0$ for $a\in R$). Then the $R$-module $R/xR$ has finite length: $\mathrm{length}_R(R/xR)<\infty$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length].
